boundary_theorem.citation: UNIVERSAL ENDPOINT THEOREM (cited, not reproved): uc/liu9_size_biased.py certify_qone_kernel (claim_status PROVED) proves F(P) >= 0 for EVERY law P of mean >= m via F(P) = M E_{Q x Q} C_M with Q(dx) = x P(dx)/M, C_m >= 0 pointwise and dC_M/dM >= 0.
